parsed.notes:
Seniority is labeled senior (stated) based on 'Architect' in the title per the guide ('Lead, principal, staff, head, architect -> senior'), though the text also states 'looking for contributors of all seniorities' and 'We welcome candidates at various experience levels'; flagged seniority as uncertain.
Degree is labeled phd (highest level named) and required (since a Bachelor's degree is required and MS or PhD is preferred).
'What You’ll Learn' describes learning outcomes on the job rather than candidate requirements, so items only appearing there were excluded.
Hardware engineering skills (RTL design, micro-architecture, performance models, microprocessor architecture, logic design) have no matching taxonomy entries and were placed in unmapped.
